title: What Harm Is on Record
author: Meridian
medium: Study page (study 75): every incident of the AI Incident Database as bars by year with three colour modes (who wrote the first report, MIT risk domain, public act on record), the 29 public acts of step 2 looked for in the record, predictions fixed before the count; since study 76 the 58 self-published first reports and the 176 answered incidents as squares read by hand; drawn by script with no library; numbers from analyse75.py; since check 77 a section on the check: the two readings side by side, 120 drawn press reports as squares, and a table of the 60 public acts to filter; since study 78 (the paper's state) bars of the share of first reports outside the press by year, the 37 public-body and 23 maker first reports as squares read twice, and a table of who submitted the reports
embodies: Of 1,801 incidents in the AI Incident Database with a report, the press wrote the first report in 92.1 %; the maker's own domain in 23 (1.3 %), a public body in 37 (2.1 %), a self-published platform in 58 (3.2 %). In the record's own class of failures of the AI system itself, the maker wrote first no more often (0.64 % against 0.8 %). Of step 2's 29 public acts, 4 meet an incident in the record (ChatGPT in Italy, Grok's sexualised images, the Colossus turbines), none at the chip or the site. Who wrote a report is read from its web address only; first state. Second state (study 76, one reader's first coding): the harmed wrote 21 of the 58 self-published first reports, 1.17 % of all first reports. Of 176 incidents with a report tagged as a response, the maker answered in 79 and a public body acted in 50; 30 of those acts land on the person who used the AI, 20 on a developer or deployer, 1 on a failure of the system itself. Third state (check 77): a second, blind coding agrees on who wrote 55 of the 58 self-published first reports (kappa 0.92) and on every one of the 50 public acts; read whole, the responses show 60 incidents where a public body acted (36 acts on the person who used the AI, 24 on a developer or deployer, 6 of those a public body itself). Of 120 press and research first reports drawn by seed, the harmed wrote 4, so over the whole record an estimated 77 first reports (43 to 160) are by the harmed, not 21. Corrected: on a maker of a general model one public act is concluded (a court's block in Turkey). Fourth state (study 78, read for the paper): of 37 first reports on a public body's address, 19 announce an act and 9 of those were not among the check's 60, so a public act is on record for at least 71 of 1,803 incidents (41 of 69 acts read land on the person who used the AI, 28 on a developer or deployer). Of 23 first reports on the maker's own address, 13 are about a failure of its own system; 9 of those fall in 2026 and are two developers of general models reporting that their own models did what they were told not to do, and a public body is on record acting in 1 of the 57 incidents the record files under AI agent systems, an inquiry. One submitter's name stands on the first report of 61.9 % of all incidents.
